description.value:
From Chocolate Disco · Price: only inside a grid you drew beforehand.

Theme Space

  • 1: 1 minute: draw a 30-ft grid. In combat, you can instead draw a 15-ft grid around your stand with 1 action; it lasts 1 minute. 1 action: teleport an unattended object in the grid to another square in it. If you teleport a loose object (a stone, a dropped weapon) into the air above a creature in the grid, it falls on it: @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[bludgeoning]] damage (@Check[reflex|against:stand|basic]{basic Reflex}).
  • 5: You can teleport an attended object (@Check[reflex|against:stand]{Reflex} negates). Surge: teleport a falling or thrown object onto a creature's square: @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[bludgeoning]] (@Check[reflex|against:stand|basic]{basic Reflex}).
  • 9: No change.
  • 13: Teleport yourself within the grid. A creature that fails its save against a falling object is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{prone}.
  • 17: Teleport a creature within the grid (@Check[will|against:stand]{Will} negates).

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
